title: Allocation Permit Register — the written authorization behind every irreversible identity allocation
authority: UCOS-LEDGER-AUTHORITY-001 (engine/ledger_authority/__init__.py). The register is READ by `_verify_permit` and written by no engine: an operator issues a permit, the chokepoint verifies it against the measured manifest, and a write that no permit authorizes is refused before anything reaches disk. This file therefore holds authorization, never authority — it creates no power to allocate and only records that a named operator approved one specific, digest-bound allocation.

constitutional_superior.effect: This register already said of itself that it holds authorization and never authority. UCKP-ART-05 — identity is owned by the root law, not by whoever writes a record of it — is the article that sentence is true UNDER. It owns the record of who approved which digest-bound allocation; it may never own the power to allocate, and a permit whose bindings do not match the measured manifest authorizes nothing at all.

$why_this_is_declared_here: RCM-AM-01, the rank-1 mechanism, because this artifact is registry-shaped and any other route would state its authority somewhere the file itself does not carry. The register is the audit trail for acts that cannot be undone; a reader holding only this file must be able to see whose authority it answers to without resolving a second document.
$append_only: Permits accumulate and are never edited or removed. A spent permit stays because the record of what was authorized is the point: `preimage_digest` self-invalidates the moment the ledger moves, so a spent permit is refused by verification rather than by deletion, and deleting it would erase the evidence of an irreversible act.

permits.$authorization: Operator-authorized identity allocation for RC-0001 elimination. Approves the one manifest the read-only --plan path measured and the operator named: 61 permanent by_path identifiers for the 52 determination documents bound to version control in this transaction plus the 9 artifacts that were committed unregistered. permits.head: a4f56e83e73fbe074cff9b089c9aa32b3b960560
permits.$authorization: Operator-authorized identity allocation clearing UGA-INV-01, UGA-INV-05 and UGA-INV-10. Approves the one manifest `uga_engine.py run --plan` measured over the index at head a4f56e83e73fbe074cff9b089c9aa32b3b960560: 101 permanent by_object identifiers, in two groups the operator was shown separately, 84 predating this transaction and 17 created by it. THE FIRST GROUP, 84, PREDATES THIS TRANSACTION and is debt the gate has been reporting against itself: 53 determination and report markdown documents at the repository root and under 00-MASTER/, the 8 context and independence registers under 00-BOOK/DATA/ bound to version control by commit 3c1a2530 (UCOS-UCTX-001), ukctx.py and its 5 sibling tools, the 6 engine modules of engine/substrate/ and engine/omega_infinite/, 7 of their test modules, the uctx and ufi gate workflows, EXECUTION-BACKLOG.json and UCOS-SUB-001's own declaration. `./verify.sh` has refused on these since they were tracked; a gate measuring its own debt and refusing to discharge it is precisely what UGA-INV-01 is for, and this permit is the instrument that was always required to answer it. Six of them are the producers behind UGA-INV-05: .claude/CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/ucos.mdc, .kiro/steering/ucos.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md and 00-BOOK/CONTEXT/ are generated by an anonymous ukctx.py, so that invariant closes as a consequence of the first group and not by a separate act. THE SECOND GROUP, 17, IS THIS TRANSACTION'S OWN WORK: 16 test modules admitted by the coverage programme that took the repository above 97.1942% under the CD-02 floor, and the sub-gate workflow that runs UCOS-SUB-001 in CI. They must be tracked to exist - a suite that runs locally and is present in no clone is the exact defect Omega-4's unreachable_artifacts note already records - and a tracked file is a UCOS-UGA-001 object, so identity is what admitting them costs. Scoped to by_object alone: by_path is UMB-IMP-001's map and this permit grants nothing there. Bound to manifest_digest, preimage_digest and head, so it authorizes this allocation and no other. Single-use: the pre-image binding is spent the moment the ledger moves, so a replay is refused by _verify_permit rather than by convention.

permits.head: a4f56e83e73fbe074cff9b089c9aa32b3b960560
permits.$authorization: Operator-authorized CORPUS_REGISTRATION reconciling the identity gap that `register.sh --observe` has been reporting as a FAILED observation (exit 4), which is the one stage `./verify.sh --full` admits that `--integration` does not. Approves the one manifest `ukb.py build --mint --plan` measured over the index at head a4f56e83e73fbe074cff9b089c9aa32b3b960560: 9 permanent by_path identifiers and their artifacts.json entries. WHAT THE 9 ARE, AND THAT NONE OF THEM IS THIS PROGRAMME'S WORK. All nine are root-level determination and analysis documents committed by 3c1a2530 on 2026-09-01: CHANGE-SET-CERTIFICATION-DETERMINATION.md, COMMIT-CLOSURE-DETERMINATION.md, GENERATED-ARTIFACT-COMMIT-AUTHORITY-DETERMINATION.md, ROOT-CAUSE-ANALYSIS.md, SHELL-OBSERVABILITY-CLOSURE-DETERMINATION.md, UFI-NO-CELL-ROOT-CAUSE.md, UNCONDITIONAL-COMMIT-READINESS-DETERMINATION.md, UNIVERSAL-CERTIFICATION-CLOSURE-DETERMINATION.md and W4-UFI-FAILURE-MATRIX.md. They are eligible artifacts that entered the corpus boundary without a corpus registration, and the coverage programme that raised this repository above 98% neither authored nor modified any of them. It surfaced them: the observation stage was never reached while earlier stages failed. WHY THIS IS A SECOND AUTHORIZATION AND NOT A CONTINUATION OF THE FIRST. P-UCOS-COVERAGE-001 allocated by_object identity under UCOS-UGA-001 and these nine already hold it - the observation report says so in terms, `these artifacts already hold UGA identity - they are not anonymous`. What is missing is a different thing owned by a different authority: the by_path map is UMB-IMP-001's, CORPUS_REGISTRATION is its own class in 00-BOOK/DATA/mutation-governance-boundary.json, and REG-AUTO-001 governs it. Scoped to by_path alone, so this permit grants nothing in by_object. Bound to manifest_digest, preimage_digest and head, so it authorizes this allocation and no other. Single-use: the pre-image binding is spent the moment the ledger moves, so a replay is refused by _verify_permit rather than by convention.
